description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer DEC color-definition checkpoint: safe Rust owns DCS 2$p HLS/RGB percentage color definitions, omission/clamp/wrap semantics, multi-entry updates and RIS restoration to Campbell.

entries.notes: ColorTableState reproduces Microsoft's complete DEC DCS 2$p contract: all 16 VT340-derived HLS vectors, all 16 RGB-percentage vectors, multiple slash-separated definitions, omitted components defaulting to zero, hue wrapping, percentage clamping, and RIS restoration of the initial 16-entry Campbell palette.
